---
name: "Risk"
description: "Use when estimating Risk for an Azure DevOps work item. Requires the Threat Model to drive the estimate."
---

# Risk Format

Estimate Risk from the work item's Threat Model.

- **1 — High** — The Threat Model identifies threats with significant likelihood or impact and no fully effective mitigation.
- **2 — Medium** — The Threat Model identifies threats that are adequately mitigated but still warrant attention.
- **3 — Low** — The Threat Model identifies no material threat, or all identified threats have strong, well-established mitigations.

Base the Risk value on the specific threats and mitigations recorded in the Threat Model table. Do not set Risk before the Threat Model is complete.
